Cloud Billing posts budget threshold breaches to Pub/Sub topic ${BUDGET_PUBSUB_TOPIC}. A Cloud Function subscriber invokes handleBudgetAlert() from platform/src/lib/observability/budget_guard.ts which (a) inserts a gate_status row and (b) at >=100% flips BUDGET_KILL_SWITCH_ENABLED. The alert policy below also pages the on-call channel directly so the operator is awake when the kill-switch engages.

Apply via:
  gcloud alpha billing budgets create --billing-account=${BILLING_ACCOUNT} \
    --display-name=marsys-monthly-cap --budget-amount=500USD \
    --threshold-rule=percent=0.5,basis=current-spend \
    --threshold-rule=percent=0.8,basis=current-spend \
    --threshold-rule=percent=1.0,basis=current-spend \
    --threshold-rule=percent=1.2,basis=current-spend \
    --notifications-rule-pubsub-topic=projects/${PROJECT_ID}/topics/${BUDGET_PUBSUB_TOPIC}
